Preprocessed Marching Cubes is an implementation variant of the Marching Cubes algorithm that incorporates preprocessing steps to improve the quality of the extracted mesh.
It is commonly used in medical imaging and 3D reconstruction pipelines where raw voxel data may contain noise or artifacts.
